issues.legal_issue: A confirmed purchase notice under Section 49(7) of the Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act causes a reservation to lapse when the appropriate authority fails to apply to acquire the land within one year.
The lapse of a reservation under Section 49 following a purchase notice is not defeated merely because the owner later sells the land to a purchaser.

After the statutory period for acquisition has elapsed, a reservation lapses under Section 127 when the authority fails to acquire the land or commence the required acquisition steps within twelve months of a purchase notice.
Once a reservation has lapsed under Section 127, the land is released from the reservation and is available for development as otherwise permitted under the relevant plan.

The prescribed acquisition timelines under Sections 126 and 127 of the Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act must be observed and cannot leave a landowner's property subject to an indefinite restriction.
